niches.label: Mythology
niches.art_style_prompt_suffix: epic mythological digital painting, dramatic lighting, rich color, cinematic composition
niches.image_prompt_rules: Every character has exactly ONE head unless the deity is specifically known for multiple heads (e.g. Brahma=4 heads, Shesha=many heads). For non-humanoid avatars describe correct animal anatomy (Kurma=single-headed giant tortoise, Matsya=fish, Varaha=boar-headed). For deities with multiple arms state the exact count (e.g. 'four arms'). Faces must be serene and clearly rendered. Specify the main subject prominently in the foreground.

hindu.label: Hindu Mythology
hindu.art_style_prompt_suffix: ancient Indian temple mural painting style, vibrant saffron and gold palette, intricate mandala patterns, jewel-toned robes, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, perfect anatomy, epic cinematic composition

norse.label: Norse Mythology
norse.art_style_prompt_suffix: dark Norse saga illustration, runic stone engravings aesthetic, muted steel blues and iron grays, dramatic stormy Nordic skies, Viking age warriors and gods, cinematic composition

egypt.label: Egyptian Mythology
egypt.art_style_prompt_suffix: Egyptian hieroglyphic art style, golden desert haze, papyrus texture backdrop, lapis lazuli and gold palette, pharaonic regalia and animal-headed gods, cinematic composition

greek.label: Greek Mythology
greek.art_style_prompt_suffix: ancient Greek vase painting meets epic digital art, marble white and Aegean blue palette, classical sculpture aesthetic, dramatic Olympian lighting, togas and bronze armor, cinematic composition

niches.label: Scary Stories
niches.art_style_prompt_suffix: cinematic horror photograph, photorealistic, real location, natural lighting, desaturated palette, deep shadow with visible detail in it, no illustration
niches.image_prompt_rules: Depict LITERALLY what the narration describes — the exact place, the exact objects, and the exact NUMBER of them (five tents means five tents visible), the light source, the weather. If the narration says it was cold outside the door, show that door with mist beyond it. A person may appear, but only turned away, silhouetted, distant or half in shadow — never a visible face and never visible hands, because generated anatomy distorts. One subject per image: never a screen showing another scene, or a reflection of somewhere else.

niches.label: Heists
niches.art_style_prompt_suffix: sleek noir-thriller digital painting, high contrast, cinematic composition
niches.image_prompt_rules: No humans, no human figures, no faces, no hands — images are generated and human anatomy distorts. Focus on vaults, cash, blueprints, tools, vehicles, empty corridors, cityscapes at night. Specify the main subject prominently in the foreground.

niches.label: Space & Science
niches.art_style_prompt_suffix: cosmic nebula deep space photography cinematic
niches.image_prompt_rules: No humans, no human figures, no faces, no hands. Focus on celestial bodies, telescopes, lab equipment, natural phenomena, data visualizations. Specify the main subject prominently in the foreground.

niches.label: AI & Tech Tools
niches.art_style_prompt_suffix: modern technology screen interface minimal cinematic
niches.image_prompt_rules: No humans, no human figures, no faces, no hands. Focus on screens, UI mockups, devices, abstract tech/data visuals. Specify the main subject prominently in the foreground.

niches.label: Finance Facts
niches.art_style_prompt_suffix: finance business city skyline charts cinematic
niches.image_prompt_rules: No humans, no human figures, no faces, no hands. Focus on charts, currency, skylines, financial data visuals. Specify the main subject prominently in the foreground.

quality_gate._comment: Inline vision-model quality check. Rejects images scoring below threshold and retries. Needs Ollama + qwen2.5vl:3b (same as image_critic). Adds ~15s per scene per attempt.

image_critic._comment: Local vision-model audit of generated images. Runs after a video is built, never during it; findings land in prompt_notes.json and improve the next run's prompts. Scaffolding for a young pipeline — set enabled false once the prompts stabilise.
